generate_ops_compile_equation: generate reshape and transpose ops from an einshape equation and input tensor shape
generate_ops_with_index_sizes: generate ops from a shape equation with explicit index size hints for ungrouping dimensions
generate_ops_wildcard: generate ops from an einshape equation using the ellipsis wildcard to match arbitrary trailing dimensions
generate_ops_broadcast: generate ops that broadcast new axes into the output shape using index size hints
generate_ops_transpose: generate ops to transpose tensor axes by reordering indices in the einshape equation RHS
